pages.text: NOOP means "no operation". A NOOP line does nothing. Use it to separate parts of your program. A NOOP line may not hold any other block. Every FUNCTION needs a NOOP line right above it.

A COMMENT block holds a note for humans. Put it at the end of a line. The cursor ignores it and every block after it. So a COMMENT in front of blocks switches them off.$(br2)A line that starts with a COMMENT block is a comment line. It is skipped like a NOOP line.
$(1)// A comment line is skipped completely$(br)VARIABLE time INTEGER 1 // a comment at the end$(br)ASSIGN count time ; COMMENT("disabled") + 100 ;$()
In the last line, $(1)COMMENT("disabled")$() is a COMMENT block with the text "disabled". The $(1)+ 100 ;$() after it is switched off.
